name: Libya
regionName: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan

indicators.indicator: Political stability and absence of violence

profile.languages: Arabic (official), Italian, English (all widely understood in the major cities); Tamazight (Nafusi, Ghadamis, Suknah, Awjilah, Tamasheq)
profile.religions: Muslim (official; virtually all Sunni) 96.6%, Christian 2.7%, Buddhist <1%, Hindu <1%, Jewish <1%, folk religion <1%, other <1%, unaffiliated <1% (2020 est.)
profile.legalSystem: Libya's post-revolution system is in flux and driven by state and non-state entities
profile.location: Northern Africa, bordering the Mediterranean Sea, between Egypt, Tunisia, and Algeria
